scheme_name: Insurance Scheme For Artisans Component of the Development of Handicrafts Scheme
description:
The Insurance Scheme for Artisans is a vital component of the Development of Handicrafts Scheme launched by the Government of India.

This scheme was officially launched in 2002 to provide social security to artisans engaged in the handicraft sector.

The primary objective of this scheme is to offer life and disability insurance coverage to artisans.

The scheme aims to cover approximately 1.5 million artisans across the country.

It seeks to provide financial assistance to artisans in the event of unforeseen circumstances such as death or disability.

The scheme offers a life insurance coverage of INR 2 lakh for the insured artisan.

In addition to life insurance, the scheme provides a disability insurance coverage of INR 1 lakh.

The premium for the insurance coverage is subsidized by the Government of India.

Artisans are required to pay a nominal premium of INR 100 per annum.

The government bears the remaining cost of the premium, which amounts to approximately INR 1,900.

The scheme is designed to ensure that artisans can continue their craft without the fear of financial instability due to unforeseen events.

Eligibility for the scheme is primarily focused on artisans engaged in traditional handicrafts.

Artisans must be aged between 18 to 59 years to qualify for the insurance coverage.

The annual income of the artisan should not exceed INR 2 lakh to be eligible for the scheme.

Artisans must be registered under the Development of Handicrafts Scheme to avail of the benefits.

The application process for the scheme involves several steps.

Artisans need to fill out an application form available at designated offices.

The application form requires personal details such as name, age, and income.

Artisans must submit proof of their handicraft work along with the application.

Documents required include identity proof such as Aadhar card or voter ID.

Artisans must also provide income proof such as income tax returns or salary slips.

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities.

After verification, eligible artisans receive an insurance policy document.

The insurance coverage is effective from the date of policy issuance.

The scheme operates under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India.

The Handicrafts Development Commissioner is the implementing authority for this scheme.

The contact details for the Handicrafts Development Commissioner can be found on the official Ministry of Textiles website.

The scheme is reviewed periodically to enhance its effectiveness and reach.

Artisans can renew their insurance policy annually by paying the nominal premium.

The disbursement of insurance claims is processed within 30 days of receiving the claim application.

In case of the death of the insured artisan, the nominee can claim the insurance amount.

For disability claims, artisans must provide medical documents certifying the disability.

The scheme has been instrumental in providing a safety net for artisans.

It has significantly contributed to the overall welfare of the handicraft community.

The Government of India has allocated a budget of INR 50 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote and support traditional crafts and artisans.

The insurance scheme has seen a steady increase in enrollment since its inception.

In 2022, approximately 1 million artisans were enrolled under the scheme.

The government aims to increase this number to 1.5 million by the end of 2024.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of financial literacy among artisans.

Workshops and awareness programs are conducted to educate artisans about the benefits of the scheme.

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries.

Many artisans have reported increased confidence in their craft due to the financial security provided.

The impact of the scheme is evident in the growth of the handicraft sector.

The handicraft sector contributes significantly to India's GDP, accounting for around 2% of the total GDP.

The sector also provides employment to over 7 million artisans across the country.

The Insurance Scheme for Artisans is a crucial step towards ensuring the sustainability of this sector.

The government continues to explore ways to enhance the benefits of the scheme.

Future plans include increasing the insurance coverage amounts to provide better security.

The scheme is also expected to expand its reach to include more artisans from remote areas.

The government is committed to promoting the welfare of artisans through various initiatives.

The Insurance Scheme for Artisans stands as a testament to this commitment.

Artisans are encouraged to take advantage of this scheme to secure their future.

The scheme plays a significant role in empowering artisans and preserving traditional crafts.

It is a vital resource for artisans facing financial hardships due to unexpected events.

The government remains dedicated to improving the lives of artisans through such welfare schemes.

The Insurance Scheme for Artisans is a critical component of the Development of Handicrafts Scheme.

It embodies the government's efforts to uplift and support the handicraft community in India.
